notes:
Summary: mid-market product company building a contextual support assistant + doc search layer integrated into product. Started with Redwood hosted API to validate latency/cost and UX. After 3 weeks of trial they want a path to Dedicated for predictable throughput and to meet VPC/data controls.

Trial observations / customer-provided telemetry: avg QPS ~8-12 during normal hours, steady-state concurrency ~10-15, afternoon peaks hit 45-62 QPS (bursty), 99th percentile latency target 150-300ms for short replies. Token mix (generation calls): ~70% short prompts (50-150 tokens request + 50-250 token response), ~20% medium (150-800 tokens), ~10% long (>=2k tokens for long-form summaries). Embeddings workload runs as asynchronous batch jobs: ~200k embeddings/day during nightly windows (not latency-sensitive). Streaming enabled on chat routes; function calling used for structured actions.

Product/POC asks: need a detailed QPS-by-route export and per-route token histogram to finalize Dedicated sizing. Concerned about cost delta vs hosted—asking for regression plan so they can fallback to hosted in case of Dedicated capacity degradation. Legal asks for data residency in us-east and bring-your-own-KMS (BYOK).

Redwood SE notes / recommendations from 2026-02-25 call: recommend initial Dedicated pool sized for 95th percentile observed traffic: equivalent to 6 x H100-style GPUs with autoscale cushion to 9 for monthly spikes; aim for concurrency slots ~50 to meet peak QPS with target latency SLOs. Suggested config: 2 routing tiers (fast-lane low-latency for chat; batch-lane for embeddings/long-form) + automatic fallback to hosted model family if on-prem capacity exhausted. Suggested Optimize presets: conservative batching for chat (preserve latency) and aggressive batching for nightly embedding jobs.

Sales/Commercial: discussed 12-month reserved capacity pricing with step-down unit rates at commit tiers. Finance wants final per-route QPS histogram + projection for next 12 months before procurement approval.

Quotes / customer voice snippets: "Hosted trial proved integration quickly but our finance team needs firm numbers on Dedicated capacity and predictable unit costs." — Head of Platform. "We need a capacity plan that handles our weekly peak and gives us a clean fallback to hosted if we need it." — Engineering manager.

Next actions / quick list: 1) AE to send POC sizing template (done, 2026-03-10). 2) Customer to export per-route token histograms and attach (owner: Arborway infra, ETA 2026-03-17). 3) Schedule follow-up capacity workshop with Redwood infra (target week of 2026-03-22). 4) Legal to finish data residency/KMS signoff (pending).
